summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test of ported Mock Test Club app on preview URL. 17/18 pytest cases passed (1 stale-data test failure not a production bug). Rate limiting, server-side scoring, answer-key hiding, idempotent double-submit, server-side timer, RBAC, role login, and health endpoint all verified working. Frontend login → student dashboard works.

minor.issue: When a student already submitted an attempt for a test (without retake pass), start returns the previously-submitted attempt object (status='submitted'). This is by design (one-attempt lock) but can confuse a client that assumes start returns an in-progress attempt. Frontend appears to handle it, but consider returning 409/status hint so clients don't call /attempts/submit on a submitted id (which no-ops).

issues: Recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' logged twice on first render — chart container mounts before layout width available. Not user-visible but noisy console.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /api/attempts/start, when returning an already-submitted attempt, either raise 409 or add a flag (e.g. 'already_submitted': true) so client can navigate to result screen rather than fetch/submit path.
OPTIONAL: Silence Recharts width=-1 warning by giving chart container an explicit min-height or gating render on layout ready.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3208 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split by domain (auth, attempts, tests, questions, ai, live, rewards, etc.) into routers before adding more features.

Rate limiter uses request.headers['x-forwarded-for'] first hop as key. On a Kubernetes ingress that fronts through multiple internal proxies this can be spoofable and/or share buckets across users behind NAT. Confirmed working end-to-end (15/16 rapid logins got 429), but consider anchoring per-user for authenticated endpoints and layering an ingress-level WAF for login.

submit_attempt catches every Exception silently around ends_at/started_at parsing (line 647-656). If parsing fails, time_taken_seconds stays None and late_submission stays False — a client could feed malformed timestamps via manual DB tamper only, so low-risk, but log at warning level instead of pass.

Post-submit fire-and-forget: asyncio.create_task(...) is spawned inside a broad try/except that logs failures but never awaits. Consider a task registry / structured logging so silent AI/email failures are observable.
test_credentials: admin@examnest.io/Admin@123/admin, student1@examnest.io/Student@123/student, teacher1@examnest.io/Teacher@123/teacher, parent1@examnest.io/Parent@123/parent (all confirmed working)
seed_data_creation: Startup seed is idempotent and populated. Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed questions/tests and cleans them up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate limit at login is 10/60s per client-IP; when running pytest for auth-heavy tests, use -p no:xdist or add sleeps between login-heavy modules to avoid false 429s. The one failing pytest case (TestStudentCriticalPath::test_student_full_flow expecting 'time_taken_seconds' in submit response) is stale-data — student1 already has a submitted attempt so /attempts/start returns the old attempt lacking that field. Reset the DB or use a fresh student email to make it green. Verified WORKING: /api/health, all 4 role logins, wrong-role/wrong-password 401, /api/questions admin-only (students/parents 403), student view of /api/tests/{id}?include_questions=true has NO 'correct' pre- or post-submit and NO 'explanation' pre-submit, admin retains 'correct', full student take-test E2E, idempotent double-submit (score unchanged), server-side score+timer fields, RBAC on question create/test delete, attempts scoped to self even with user_id override, admin create question+test, rate limit 429 at 11th request/min on login.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. Minor stale-test-data pytest failure documented above.
